ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: <image_1> An 'arrow-pushing' diagram is a common type of chemical image used to illustrate electron flow in mechanistic steps. The transition-state structure undergoes changes after the electron has been relocated or reacted. Which of the following options shows the structure after the change? Note: Disregard the arrows in the options. The selected option should represent the immediate product of the next step, not the final product of the reaction.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the starting material in the figure is an N-sulfonyl chloride-substituted isocyanate fragment, which can be written as O=C=N–S(=O)2Cl; below there is methanol CH3OH. The curved arrow shows the lone pair electrons of the methanol oxygen attacking the central carbon of the isocyanate, and another curved arrow shows the π electrons of C=N moving toward nitrogen. Then reason: according to these arrows, only one step is executed; the methanol oxygen forms a new C–O bond with the isocyanate carbon; the original C=N double bond becomes a C–N single bond, and the electron pair falls onto nitrogen, therefore nitrogen carries a negative charge; the carbonyl O remains as C=O, and the N–S(=O)2Cl connection remains unchanged. Since the methanol oxygen still connects to CH3 and H, and at the same time newly connects to the carbonyl carbon, this oxygen is in an oxonium form and carries a positive charge. The immediate product is not the neutral product after proton transfer, but a zwitterionic adduct.

method.method_draft: Describe the starting image, then apply each curved arrow once: keep the S(=O)2Cl group and carbonyl O unchanged; form a new bond between the methanol oxygen and the central isocyanate carbon; break/reduce the C=N π bond so carbon is single-bonded to N; place the electron pair on N, giving N a negative charge; because methanol oxygen used a lone pair while still attached to H and CH3, represent it as an oxonium substituent O(H)CH3 attached to the carbon. The immediate structure is therefore the zwitterionic adduct O=C(–O(H)CH3)–N(–)–SO2Cl, not the proton-transfer final product.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中起始物是一个 N-磺酰氯取代的异氰酸酯片段，可写作 O=C=N–S(=O)2Cl；下方有甲醇 CH3OH。弯箭头显示甲醇氧的孤对电子进攻异氰酸酯的中心碳，另一个弯箭头显示 C=N 的 π 电子移向氮。再推理：按这些箭头只执行一步，甲醇氧与异氰酸酯碳形成新的 C–O 键；原来的 C=N 双键变为 C–N 单键，电子对落到氮上，因此氮带负电；羰基 O 保持为 C=O，N–S(=O)2Cl 连接保持不变。由于甲醇氧仍连接 CH3 和 H，同时又新连到羰基碳，所以该氧为氧鎓形式，带正电。立即产物不是质子转移后的中性产物，而是两性离子加合物。
